questions.questionText: Which of the following options is incorrect in reference to matrix method of structure analysis?

options.html: Elements of leading diagonal of stiffness matrix can be negative
options.text: Elements of leading diagonal of stiffness matrix can be negative

options.html: Elements of main diagonal of flexibility matrix are always positive.
options.text: Elements of main diagonal of flexibility matrix are always positive.

options.html: Flexibility matrix and its transpose are equal.
options.text: Flexibility matrix and its transpose are equal.

options.html: Stiffness matrix is a symmetric matrix.
options.text: Stiffness matrix is a symmetric matrix.

questions.explanationHtml:
(a)
• Flexibility stiffnes matrix is equal to its transpose (A′ = A symmetric matrix) as it is a square matrix and its elements are symmetrical about main diagonal.
• Elements of main diagonal (leading diagonal) of stiffness/flexibility matrix are always positive.
